title: Quarter past and quarter to
examples: Why is it called a quarter?

explain.say: A clock face can be split into 4 equal parts. Each part is a quarter of an hour. That is 15 minutes. Look at the board. The long hand is on 3. It is quarter past 4.
Past means after. Quarter past 4 means 15 minutes after 4 o'clock. The long hand moved from 12 to 3. The short hand is just past 4.
After 1 more quarter, the long hand reaches 6. That is 2 quarters, or half the circle. It is half past 4. That is 30 minutes after 4.
After 1 more quarter, the long hand is on 9. 1 quarter is left before 5 o'clock. So we say quarter to 5. To means before. The short hand is nearly at 5.
This is quarter to 10. The long hand is on 9. The short hand is nearly on 10. Quarter to names the next hour. A digital clock shows 9 45.

faq.a: Quarter past means 15 minutes after the hour. The minute hand points to 3, a quarter of the way round the clock.
Quarter to means 15 minutes before the next hour. The minute hand points to 9. Quarter to 5 is the same as four forty-five.

faq.q: Why is it called a quarter?
faq.a: A quarter is one of 4 equal parts. An hour is 60 minutes, and a quarter of 60 is 15, so a quarter of an hour is 15 minutes.

faq.q: Why does quarter to use the next hour?
faq.a: Because it tells you how long is left until that hour. At quarter to 5, there are 15 minutes to go until 5 o'clock.
asks: Why is it quarter to 5 and not quarter to 4?

faq.q: Where does the minute hand point at each quarter?
faq.a: At o'clock it points to 12, at quarter past to 3, at half past to 6, and at quarter to it points to 9.

facts: A quarter of an hour is 15 minutes.
Quarter to 5 is the same time as 4:45.

quiz.say: The minute hand points to 3. The hour hand is just past 7. What time is it?
quiz.show: Minute hand on 3, hour hand just past 7. Time?
quiz.why: The minute hand on 3 means quarter past. The hour hand is just past 7, so it is quarter past 7.

wrong.0: At quarter to, the minute hand points to 9.
wrong.1: The minute hand points to 3. The hour hand shows the hour.

quiz.say: Which digital time is the same as quarter to 8?
quiz.why: Quarter to 8 is 15 minutes before 8 o'clock. That is 7:45.
